name: Quinn Davis
bio:
Quinn Davis is an experienced project manager with a strong track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget. With expertise in agile methodologies, risk management, and stakeholder engagement, Quinn ensures that every project at Code Collider meets the highest standards of quality and client satisfaction.

Quinn has successfully managed projects across various industries, from technology implementations to organizational transformations. Their collaborative leadership style and attention to detail have earned them recognition as a trusted project leader. Quinn is a certified Scrum Master and PMP, with additional certifications in PRINCE2 and Agile methodologies.

When not managing projects, Quinn enjoys rock climbing, reading about leadership, and participating in project management community events.
